h1: Custom Steel Candles for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom steel candles in bulk at Perfect Imprints. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Get started today!
introHtml: Steel candle tins offer a rugged, industrial look that stands out from standard glass or ceramic containers. They are lightweight, unbreakable, and ideal for trade shows, employee gifts, or safety kits. The screw-top metal tin design keeps the candle secure during shipping and allows for easy relighting. Customize with your logo using full-color labels or screen printing for a durable finish that lasts.
heroAltText: Bulk custom steel candles in screw-top metal tins with lemon verbena scent, ideal for corporate gifts.
